k:HH.Setting.casino.blackjackPays.Desc: 3:2 = 1.5, 6:5 = 1.2. Changes the house edge by about 1.4 points.
k:HH.Setting.casino.chipSpendBonus: Spending bonus with a cashier's cage
k:HH.Setting.casino.chipSpendBonus.Desc: Guests bring this much more to the tables when a cage sells chips ("doesn't feel like money").
k:HH.Setting.casino.chipTakeHome.Desc: At most this share of a guest's winnings stays on them as chips when they leave: pure house profit ("chip float").
k:HH.Setting.casino.colonistChips.Desc: Colonists gamble with worthless house chips: no colony silver is ever lost at the tables.
k:HH.Setting.casino.comfortSpend.Desc: A guest on a seat with comfort 100 % stakes this much more per round (scaled by the seat's comfort; standing = no bonus). The house edge stays the same: more play, not better odds.
k:HH.Setting.casino.comfortStay.Desc: A guest on a seat with comfort 100 % plays this much longer before leaving the table.
k:HH.Setting.casino.croupierRequired.Des: Roulette, blackjack and Rimdeck only run for guests while a colonist with the Serving work type staffs the table. Slot machines never need one.
k:HH.Setting.casino.fatalDespair.Desc: Reserved. Nothing in this module can kill a colonist; the switch has no effect.
k:HH.Setting.casino.guestBetShare.Desc: A guest stakes this share of their gambling money per round. The default is larger than in a real casino because the tables run far fewer rounds per in-game hour; hourly takings stay about the same.
k:HH.Setting.casino.guestBudgetShare.Des: Share of a guest's remaining budget they bring to the tables (before personality).
k:HH.Setting.casino.guestMinBuyIn.Desc: Guests with less to spend do not gamble.
k:HH.Setting.casino.guestStopLoss.Desc: A guest leaves the tables after losing this share of their gambling money.
k:HH.Setting.casino.guestWinTarget.Desc: A guest cashes out after winning this share on top of their gambling money.
k:HH.Setting.casino.houseFloat.Desc: Cash the house keeps in its drawer. Whatever it wins above this (plus what guests currently play with) goes to the colony till when the casino closes.
k:HH.Setting.casino.houseRiskLimit.Desc: Caps each bet at cash ÷ (4 · σ · √rounds per day): a bad night cannot break the house. The cap shrinks when the cash is low.
k:HH.Setting.casino.howToSeen.Desc: Remembers that the short game explanations of the Lucky Thrumbo opened once by themselves. Turn it off to see them open again.
k:HH.Setting.casino.joyGain.Desc: Joy gain compared with a vanilla poker table.
k:HH.Setting.casino.maxBet.Desc: Largest stake at any game while limits are enforced.
k:HH.Setting.casino.minBet.Desc: Smallest stake. Fractions are fine: the bet is not paid out in coins.
k:HH.Setting.casino.pokerRake.Desc: The share of every pot the house keeps (up to the rake cap).
k:HH.Setting.casino.pokerRakeCap.Desc: The most the house takes from one pot.
k:HH.Setting.casino.reactions.Desc: Players cheer, groan and toss coins on wins, losses and near misses (small icons above their heads and short sounds).
k:HH.Setting.casino.rouletteEdge.Desc: 0.54 % to 7.9 %: small edges use a la partage wheel, 2.7 % is one zero, over 4 % is a double-zero wheel. Every bet gets exactly this edge.
k:HH.Setting.casino.roundsPerHour.slot.D: How fast a machine spins, per in-game hour (2500 ticks, so 40 is a spin every 1 to 2 real seconds at normal speed).
k:HH.Setting.casino.slotRtp.Desc: Share of the stakes a One-Armed Muffalo pays back in the long run. 92 % = house edge 8 %. Above 100 % the house loses money.
k:HH.Setting.casino.tableLimits.Desc: On: bets stay between the minimum and maximum bet below. Off: only the house risk rule limits bets.
k:HH.Setting.casino.toleranceFactor.Desc: How quickly joy tolerance builds up compared with vanilla (0.6 = 40 % slower).
k:HH.Setting.casino.worldFx.Desc: Spinning reels, the roulette wheel, dealt cards, chips and small sounds at the machines and tables while people play.
k:HH.Setting.city.cinemaCooldownHours.De: A guest sees at most one film in this time.
k:HH.Setting.city.cinemaMinSeats.Desc: A projector screen counts as a cinema when at least this many seats face it.
k:HH.Setting.city.cinemaShowTicks.Desc: How long one screening runs. 2,500 ticks are one hour.
k:HH.Setting.city.cinemaTicket.Desc: Price of one ticket. Guests pay when they sit down.
k:HH.Setting.city.desireScale.Desc: Scales how strongly guests want to go to the cinema, salon, gallery and park bench. 0 = never.
k:HH.Setting.city.galleryCooldownHours.D: A guest goes through a gallery at most once in this time.
k:HH.Setting.city.galleryFee.Desc: Price of walking through the gallery once.
k:HH.Setting.city.galleryMaxViews.Desc: How many artworks one guest looks at per visit.
k:HH.Setting.city.galleryMinArt.Desc: A room counts as a gallery when it holds at least this many artworks.
k:HH.Setting.city.galleryViewTicks.Desc: How long a guest stands in front of one artwork.
k:HH.Setting.city.movieNight.Desc: Colonists organise a movie night now and then when a powered projector screen with seats exists.
k:HH.Setting.city.movieNightChance.Desc: Chance that the colony starts a movie night on a given evening (18:00).
k:HH.Setting.city.parkCooldownHours: Hours between bench visits per guest
k:HH.Setting.city.parkCooldownHours.Desc: A guest sits on a bench at most once in this time.
k:HH.Setting.city.parkRestTicks.Desc: How long somebody sits on a park bench.
k:HH.Setting.city.priceTolerance.Desc: How much guests accept to pay for city services compared with the reference price. Follows the difficulty slider; 1 = standard.
k:HH.Setting.city.researchMode.Desc: Full: the City Life projects must be researched. Off: everything in City Life is available right away.
k:HH.Setting.city.salonCooldownHours.Des: A guest gets at most one new look in this time.
k:HH.Setting.city.salonDyePrice.Desc: Extra for a hair colour change (needs Biotech or Ideology).
k:HH.Setting.city.salonPrice.Desc: What a guest pays for a haircut and a new style.
k:HH.Setting.city.salonServiceTicks.Desc: How long a haircut takes with an average stylist.
k:HH.Setting.city.salonWaitTicks.Desc: A guest waits this long in the chair for someone to turn up, then leaves unhappy.
k:HH.Setting.city.securityChance.Desc: Base chance per eligible guest; very wealthy guests (80+) get +40 points.
k:HH.Setting.city.securityDayShare.Desc: The bodyguard costs this share of the guest's budget per day, billed per hour.
k:HH.Setting.city.securityHireHours.Desc: A hire that finds no free armed colonist within this time is cancelled without charge.
k:HH.Setting.city.securityMinHourFee.Des: A bodyguard never costs less than this per hour.
k:HH.Setting.city.securityMinWealth.Desc: Guests below this wealth level (1 to 100) never hire protection.
k:HH.Setting.city.securityOn.Desc: Wealthy guests may hire one of your armed colonists as a bodyguard.
k:HH.Setting.city.taxiArrivalChance.Desc: Share of arriving guests who are dropped off at the taxi stand instead of walking in from the map edge.
